List any details of the original omitted, added, or changed in EACH version: task, entity, numbers, persona, hobbies, research interests, constraints, certainty, options, scope. Return JSON {"a_preserves_all":true/false,"b_preserves_all":true/false,"pair_equivalent":true/false,"differences":"brief concrete omissions/additions"}.

Also, give me a 1 to 10 score on how sure you are that your take is right.", "B": "Determine which vocalist demonstrates superior technical proficiency: Floor Jansen or Katy Perry. Additionally, provide a confidence rating from 1 to 10 regarding the accuracy of your assessment."}
